leaders.name: Isaiah
leaders.flavor: Coal-touched lips. Here am I; send me. — Isaiah 6.
leaders.art: A seer with coal-touched lips beneath seraph-light, awe and resolve.

leaders.name: Elijah
leaders.text: Fire (2): Deal 1 damage to a unit.
leaders.flavor: Answer by fire. It did. — 1 Kings 18.
leaders.art: A windswept prophet, a single spark leaping from his outstretched hand.

leaders.name: Joshua

hero_power.name: Rally
hero_power.text: Give a friendly unit +1 attack this turn.

leaders.text: Rally (2): Give a friendly unit +1 attack this turn.
leaders.flavor: Be strong and courageous. He wrote it down. — Joshua 1.
leaders.art: A captain raising a ram's-horn trumpet before a marching column, dust and resolve.

leaders.name: Deborah

hero_power.name: Command
hero_power.text: Give a friendly unit +1/+1 this turn.

leaders.text: Command (2): Give a friendly unit +1/+1 this turn.
leaders.flavor: Judge, prophet, war-leader. Barak wouldn't go without her. — Judges 4.
leaders.art: A judge enthroned beneath a palm, warriors attending, calm authority.

leaders.name: Aaron
leaders.text: Intercede (2): Restore 2 health to your hero.
leaders.flavor: Stood between the living and the dead until the plague stopped. — Numbers 16.
leaders.art: A jeweled breastplate catching light, censer raised, incense-blue and white-gold.

leaders.name: Melchizedek
leaders.text: Consecrate (2): Give a friendly unit Endure.
leaders.flavor: King of Salem, priest of God Most High. No genealogy, no exit. — Genesis 14.
leaders.art: Bread and cup offered on a hilltop at dusk, the priest's face in reverent shadow.

leaders.name: David
leaders.flavor: Harp in one hand, sling in the other. — 1 Samuel 16.
leaders.art: The young shepherd with a harp on his back and a sling at his belt, dawn light.

leaders.name: Moses
leaders.flavor: Tending sheep when the bush caught fire and didn't burn. — Exodus 3.
leaders.art: A herdsman before an unconsuming flame, staff in hand, wonder on his face.

leaders.name: Abraham
leaders.flavor: Count the stars, if you can. So shall your offspring be. — Genesis 15.
leaders.art: An elder standing beneath an overwhelming field of stars, arms slightly open.

leaders.name: Sarah
leaders.flavor: She laughed. Then she named him Laughter. — Genesis 18.
leaders.art: A tent door at dusk, a knowing laugh, three long shadows on the ground beyond.

leaders.name: Peter
leaders.text: Go and Tell (2): Summon a 1/1 Disciple.
leaders.flavor: Left the nets on the beach and didn't look back. — Matthew 4.
leaders.art: A rugged fisherman turning from his nets toward an open road, morning light.

leaders.name: Paul
leaders.flavor: Wrote half the New Testament from a prison cell. — Philippians 1.
leaders.art: A prisoner writing intently by lamplight, a chain at his ankle, ink and fire.
